_comment: Two hosting sites, one build. q8d-copilot.web.app is the submission URL: a GCP
project id may not begin with a digit, so the project had to be called
d-copilot-2026 and the product's '8' was lost from the hostname. A Firebase
Hosting site id has no such rule, so a second site carries the name the product
d-copilot-2026.web.app stays listed here deliberately: it was shared before the
rename, and deploying both from the same frontend/dist means the old link serves
the current build instead of silently rotting at whatever was last pushed to it.
